bio: The baptism on the tree's date, 25 February 1797, is of Francesca Angelina Ferlaino, daughter of Giuseppe Antonio Ferlaino and Rosa Gallo ([R4-S1]). Her parents are new to the tree. She married Rosario Iera as 'Agostina' on 26 February 1812, aged about 15 ([R4-S2]). She was buried as Faustina on 3 February 1880 ([R4-S3]). The burial index gives her age as 90 and her late husband as 'Joseph'. That may be an index slip for Rosario, son of Giuseppe. The run of names (Angelina, Agostina, Faustina) needs checking on the images.
